summary: GI round 4, package PD (date step 1), studio/gi/context.py only. Wide own-date labels in the document's head (Date seen, Case date, Exam date, Date performed, Day of procedure, and the other forms of _WIDE_DATE_LABEL) and the worded date-of-service field of D2 ('Service date logged for this case: ...') only ever ASK or NARROW, and are never sent: (a) the installed reading sends X and such a label states Y: the date is asked and only X is a member's answer (the narrow release's question, read by charge_date_problem / charge_date_own / charge_question_day, so every reader still reads X); (b) the installed reading already asks with evidence: unchanged; (c) it asks with no evidence at all (any member date taken): the labels become that evidence - one value only when a closing-role line states the same day, several values as a conflict of those values - so only dates the document states are taken. Hardening: no wide or worded label is read when sections.around_procedure_title matches (the installed fact stands); corroboration only from closing-role lines among the last 8 non-empty lines, never from a consent, order, request, booking/scheduling or call/phone line. Built so that the installed candidates - and so the installed fact - are computed exactly as installed (the wide candidates are read beside them, never among them: the prototype's joint pass let _after_another_header keep an addendum's own label 'own' when a wide label stood in the head, a possible NEW-SEND), and every other text reads byte-identically.

movement_bounds.corpus: H2 as package PS ran it: the harness corpus (regression texts, generated corpus, seeded families, repository texts) plus /home/claude/cpt-studio-gi4-20261031/stage-a/out/minimal-corpus.jsonl; 51,925 texts, 281,868 text x member states
movement_bounds.how: computed BEFORE any PD code existed, from the installed tree's observation (80df1831d168) and a regex scan only (wave1/pd/probes/h2_bounds.py): PD can move only a text that carries a wide own-date label or a worded date-of-service field with a valid calendar date and is not titled as a note written around a procedure (sections.around_procedure_title, the PS rule); every other text's candidates are installed's by construction
movement_bounds.FACT-CHANGED: 20,944 = such texts (33,807 carry such a label; 12,863 of them are titled around a procedure and read none)
movement_bounds.SEND->ASK: 4,326 = such texts whose installed 'none' state sends a date (rule (a))
movement_bounds.NEW-HELD: 78,260 = every state of such texts whose answer installed took (strict bound); expected at most 59,099 = those whose answer no wide or worded label of the text states (rule (c) narrows to the stated dates; rules (a) and (b) hold nothing new)
movement_bounds.zero: NEW-SEND 0 and NEW-TAKE 0 (the gate, by construction: a wide label is never sent, rule (a) takes only installed's own date, rule (c) takes a subset of installed's 'any date'); REQUEST-CHANGED 0, LAYOUT-CHANGED 0, MENTIONS-CHANGED 0, STATE-CHANGED 0, READER-ERROR 0, TEXT-MISSING 0; every moved text is one of the counted texts (checked by set, not only by count)

battery_note: No permanent H4 row carries a wide own-date label or a worded date-of-service field (static scan of ops/gi4/battery.py CASES), so no row can move: every row's bucket, status, violations and fingerprint equal installed's.

evidence: Service date logged for this case: 10/08/2026

replay.all: every stored request sha256 rebuilds unchanged; no state sends a date it did not send; in a newly held state the request is no longer built and the assess child reads the hold (provider failed, no answer), as for every member-date hold; every other state is equal in the compact view (date channel, request, routing, inventory, proposals with fingerprints, questions, offers, completeness)

h1_hard_failures: installed 25 (date.sends-only-the-truth: h4-01 7, h4-02 4, h4-03 4, h4-04 5, h4-06 5 - each a member date taken where the own label is unread) -> 0
h3: no MUST regression and no SHOULD regression; movement only in date cells (date.send, date.answer-held, date.no-send-before-answer), fixed only; date.own-read[out] is MAY (PD2, never judged) and stays unsent
must_hold: F7: 'Pre-procedure telephone call / Day of procedure: 11/04/2026 / ... Signed ... Oct 30, 2026' and the variant signed on 11/04: the installed fact (no evidence) stands, the call's own date is taken, nothing is sent before an answer
F7: 'Endoscopy booking / Case date: 2026-11-04', with or without 'Attested: ..., 2026-11-04': the installed fact stands; 2026-11-04 is never sent by the document
'Prior colonoscopy at an outside center / Date performed: May 2, 2019' above 'Date of service: October 19, 2026': sends 2026-10-19 as installed; 2019-05-02 is never sent or taken
'Date of service: 10/06/2026' with 'Last exam date: 04/02/2025': sends 2026-10-06 as installed
X+Y head conflict 'Date of service: 10/18/2026' + 'Date performed: 10/19/2026': asked (dateless); only 2026-10-18 is taken; every reader reads 2026-10-18
a wide label never reaches a request: no state sends a date only a wide or worded label states
a closing-role line outside the last 8 non-empty lines, or on a consent, order, request, booking or call line, corroborates nothing (the installed fact stands)
a wide label in the head beside an aside header date and an authored addendum's own label: the installed fact stands exactly (never sent where installed asks)
guards_and_mutants: one killing mutant per guard, each detected by tests.test_gi4_pd (SimpleTestCase, no database): the around-procedure title hold; the last-8-lines reach; the not-a-closing-line words; the installed candidates read apart from the wide ones; plus the prototype's guards PD now carries: corroboration of a single value, the own-reading filter, the worded field's occurrence words, the head reach, and rule (a) taking only installed's date
deviations_from_the_prototype: wide and worded candidates are read beside the installed candidates (_pd_wide_candidates) and appended after the installed post-processing, so _installed_service_date_fact reads exactly the installed candidates
_head_end counts lines with sections.head_lines_end (one pass, no backtracking on a long blank line)
a worded field (words before its colon, never alone in its field) is noted with WIDE_DATE_NOTE, never with FIELD_DATE_NOTE (which says the words come after the date)
